prompts.initial: Use case: identity-preserve. Production sprite for a children's clock learning game. Edit the provided original canonical artwork of the Clock City pterosaur. Keep the exact original character and pose, framing, exact head contour and tall swept blue crest, eye positions and sizes, original smile and yellow beak, broad yellow wing membranes with cyan ribs, dark blue skin spots, cream chest and six toes, every appendage including entire wings and tail, two round gold wing clocks and gold shoulder fasteners. Keep the same left-facing camera, placement, head/body scale, diffuse lighting, 3D painted toy style and colors. Both clocks must have opaque cream dials with readable tick marks only, no digits or letters, and clear dark-blue hands. Only remove the white background and ground shadow, restoring crisp fine detail at 1254×1254 or higher. Keep full soft antialiased silhouette, fully opaque inside the character including clock faces and eyes, and actual transparent alpha outside. No white or checkerboard, shadow, halo, lettering, separate elements, or extra details. Preserve original clean space at edges.
prompts.reactions: Use case: identity-preserve, sprite sheet for a children's clock learning game. Input 1 is the exact canonical left-facing character and style; lock identical face, pupils, eye spacing, swept blue crest, yellow beak, cyan spotted skin, cream belly and toes, yellow wing membranes with teal ribs, TWO gold clocks on the wings and gold shoulder bolts. Use sharp, consistent diffuse light and 3D painted toy style. Actual transparent RGBA, no ground shadow. Exactly a 2-column by 2-row equal square-cell grid without visible divisions, no text or numbers. 2048 square if possible. Each cell contains complete character with generous blank margins, same head scale and camera, all wing tips and tail. Use identical baseline at 89% of each cell for standing poses. Cell 1 top left: palms held apart forward near chest, ready to clap, same original happy head. Cell 2 top right: palms fully meeting vertically in front of chest below beak, readable clap contact separation from face, same happy head. Cell 3 bottom left: hands relax under chin, apologetic worried expression, mouth downturned and eyebrows tilted, head on same center, keep feet planted. Cell 4 bottom right: energetic airborne tuck with elbows in, bent knees and compact wings, still left-facing same pupils and head proportions. Keep both clocks in each pose where visible, with opaque cream dials, tick marks and dark blue hands, no numerals or lettering. Preserve exact original accessories and colors. Keep every hand, toe and appendage inside its own cell.
prompts.recovery: Use case: identity-preserve. Exactly 2 by 2 equal square sprite cells on transparent RGBA, no cell lines, shadow, lettering, effects or background. The exact reference left-facing cyan pterosaur, swept crest, brown eyes, gold beak, cream belly and toes, spotted teal skin, yellow membrane wings with turquoise supports and TWO gold wing clocks with opaque cream dials, dark blue hands and ticks, same 3/4 angle and toy rendering. Full silhouette in every cell. Top left is a planted gentle crouch with head lowered and knees bent in preparation for a jump. Top right is a left-facing stumble leaning forward, arms reaching down toward ground. Bottom left is a harmless belly-low fall, kneeling with BOTH palms flat on the ground in front and tail behind. Bottom right pushes up from both palms still at the same ground contact points, shifting back onto feet. Same size of face and body from frame to frame, identical planted contact baseline at 89 percent in every cell. Each pose entirely inside its own cell including crest, wings, toes and tail. Keep original lighting, colors and design. Both wing clocks where visible retain actual cream opaque dials, with tick marks and no numerals. No motion blur.
prompts.pirouette: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit into exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square sprite cells, transparent RGBA background, no ground shadow, text, lines or effects. Reference is the identical left-facing cyan Clock City pterosaur with blue swept crest, large brown eyes, cream belly and toes, yellow beak, dark blue spots, yellow wing membranes and turquoise spars bearing two opaque cream-faced gold clocks. Keep all features, diffused illumination and soft shiny 3D toy illustration. This is a mechanically ordered upright pirouette turntable, same view height, scale, center of hips and 89% planted sole baseline; every edge of every silhouette inside its cell with margin. Keep wings half open pointing down and legs in same stance in each panel to fit. Top row left to right: 1 original front-left 3/4; 2 left profile; 3 rear-left 3/4; 4 full back. Bottom row: 5 rear-right 3/4; 6 right profile; 7 front-right 3/4; 8 almost straight front. Use visible clocks on wing front surfaces as angles permit, cream opaque dials with ticks and dark hands, no lettering. Keep the same head proportions from angle to angle, full feet, wings, tail and crest. Equal cells, fixed placement with clear separation, no cropping.
prompts.pirouetteCutout: Use case: background-extraction. Keep all eight pixel-aligned pterosaur pirouette views, exact pose, geometry, lighting and color, grid position and overall landscape aspect ratio 2:1. Remove ONLY the off-white background including the faint printed grid. Use real fully transparent RGBA around the eight characters, no canvas color, no checkerboard, no glow or shadows. Preserve fully opaque characters including the clock dials and any cream or cyan highlights. No trimming, shifting or scaling. Same eye and crest proportions. Preserve all toes, tail, wing tips, and dial marks.

production.coordinates: Top-left source pixel centers. Pose geometry below uses the registered 512-pixel canvas, including opening scaled by 512/1254. Cell registration values use native cell pixels. Preparation mirrors the figures and the geometry once (normalized x -> 1-x, raster column -> width-1-column). The screen applies normalized offsets times its sprite size in points.
production.alpha: ImageGen's low-alpha fringe was remapped to zero and its near-opaque interiors to 255. Cell boundaries use rounded proportional grid edges. Any faint floor shadow below the measured contacts was cleared before resampling.

production.maskMethod: Pose-local clock, eye, head and crest geometry, occluders in front of the clocks, and connected membrane regions seeded between wing ribs. The profile view has separate dial and bezel outlines. Dials and the painted tick marks and hands are preserved, with no numerals to mirror. Archived masks are cached independently of colors.

motion.welcome: One high-resolution idle sprite throughout the native welcome
motion.jump: Idle through one star, registered tuck during the middle of a backflip or world jump, open wings before contact
motion.turn: Idle then turn-02 through turn-08, aligned to the pelvis x=242
motion.stumble: Crouch, reach, planted fall, planted push, crouch and idle; push-up is translated -5.5/512 screen-width to share the palm midpoint
